title: 第5章 奶娘生涯奇耻大辱第6章 这还是犯倔的小魔王吗
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
张嬷嬷无限期待，眼下她已经把苏念禾当成了最后一根救命稻草。
小公子能不能吃上伙食，全看她了。
与她截然不同的是，王翠娥与沈春花。
如果眼神能杀人，怕是苏念禾已经死过千百次了。
她们带有一种看热闹不嫌事大的心态，倒是要好好瞧瞧苏念禾是怎么死的。
可偏偏事与愿违。
苏念禾竟走上前来，对着张嬷嬷说：“承蒙嬷嬷看重，小女子姑且一试。”
王翠娥与沈春花嗤之以鼻：“死鸭子嘴硬，看你还能撑到什么时候。”
“哼，干嘬可不顶饱。”
“再说了，一个黄花大丫头，对着小公子脱衣解衫，还要不要点脸……”
并幻想着苏念禾手足无措，待会儿就被小公子的震天哭吼给赶出来。
想想都觉得解气。
在众人的注视下，苏念禾款款迈进婴儿房。
她没有着急去抱小公子宋彦洲，而是对抱着他的丫鬟点头行礼。
“不知道这里有没有细软的毛巾或者棉布？”
看着丫鬟们有些不解，苏念禾抬起手臂，露出洗得发白的粗布衣袖紧着说。
“这些粗布麻衣，粗糙不堪，唯恐硌着小公子。”
“哦，有的有的，这就给你拿。”
接过软布之后，苏念禾先软布搭在了自己肩上，方便后续使用。
再将自己的衣袖挽起，这才靠近宋彦洲。

这一看差点移不开眼。
“哇咔咔，好漂亮的小公子！”
苏念禾立马星星眼，母爱都要泛滥成灾了。
这鼻子，这眼睛，这长相，完全长在了苏念禾的心巴上。
要知道一般的小婴儿出生，身上都会覆盖一层厚厚的泛白的胎脂，要落不落的斑斑驳驳，不太好看。
而且他们刚出生不久，还没有长开，身上皱皱巴巴的，脸上的褶子怪像小老头的。
可宋彦洲不一样。
他除了脑门上些许胎脂，其他地方全都是白白净净的，白里透粉，就好像飘粉的羊脂玉。
让人看的赏心悦目，忍不住想去戳一戳。
虽然他的眼睛还没有全部睁开，但眼缝细长，眼角开得很大，以苏念禾的经验，这绝对是一双勾魂摄魄的桃花眼。
还有他高耸的鼻梁，粉红的小嘴唇……修长的四肢，真是越看越让人稀罕。
苏念禾暗中感慨：都说人类是女娲娘娘抟土捏出来的，是批量。
但这绝对是精修的！
小公子宋彦洲听到苏念禾的声音，努力抬了抬头，循着声音看过去。
好吧，他失败了。
脑袋不受控制的歪向了另一边。
哼哼唧唧，费了好大力气才回正，小嘴撇成了一个typec的委屈样儿。
周围的人全都屏住了呼吸，害怕那一声啼哭犹如破晓的惊雷划破长空。
王翠娥与沈春花心里默念着：哭，快哭啊，赶紧把那个小贱人给哭走！
content_en:
Nanny Zhang has endless expectations, and now she has regarded Su Nianhe as the last straw.
Whether the young master can eat or not depends entirely on her.
Completely different from her are Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua.
If looks could kill, Su Nianhe would have died thousands of times.
They had the mentality of just watching the excitement, but they wanted to see how Su Nianhe died.
But it just backfired.
Su Nianhe actually stepped forward and said to Nanny Zhang, "Thanks to Nanny Zhang for your respect, I will give it a try, little lady."
Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua sneered: "You damn duck has a tough mouth, let's see how long you can last."
"Huh, sucking it all won't satisfy you."
"Besides, a yellow-haired girl strips off her clothes in front of a young master and has no shame..."
He also imagined that Su Nianhe was at a loss and would be driven out by the young master's loud cries.
Just thinking about it makes me feel relieved.
Under the gaze of everyone, Su Nianhe stepped into the baby room.
She did not rush to hug the young master Song Yanzhou, but nodded and saluted the maid holding him.
"I wonder if there are any soft towels or cotton cloth here?"
Seeing that the maids were a little confused, Su Nianhe raised his arms, revealing the white washed coarse cloth sleeves and said tightly.
"These coarse linen clothes are so rough that they might hurt the young master."
"Oh, there's some. Here I'll get it for you."
After taking the soft cloth, Su Nianhe first put it on his shoulders to facilitate subsequent use.
Then he rolled up his sleeves and approached Song Yanzhou.
I almost couldn't take my eyes away at this sight.
"Wow, what a beautiful young master!"
Su Nianhe's eyes immediately widened with maternal love.
This nose, these eyes, this appearance are all in Su Nianhe's heart.
You should know that when an ordinary baby is born, his body will be covered with a thick layer of whitish vernix, which is mottled and unsightly.
Moreover, they were just born and haven't grown yet. Their bodies are wrinkled and the wrinkles on their faces look like those of a little old man.
But Song Yanzhou was different.
Except for a little bit of vernix on his forehead, the rest of his body was completely white and pink, just like powdered mutton-fat jade.
It’s so pleasing to the eye that you can’t help but want to poke it.
Although his eyes have not been fully opened, the slits are slender and the corners of the eyes are wide open. Based on Su Nianhe's experience, these are definitely a pair of captivating peach blossom eyes.
And his tall nose, small pink lips... and slender limbs are really more and more rare the more you look at them.
Su Nianhe secretly sighed: It is said that human beings were kneaded out of soil by Empress Nuwa. They were made in batches.
But it’s definitely polished!
When the young master Song Yanzhou heard Su Nianhe's voice, he tried his best to raise his head and looked over following the voice.
Well, he failed.
His head tilted to the other side uncontrollably.
He hummed, and it took a lot of effort to get back to his straight position, his mouth curled into a typec look of grievance.
Everyone around them held their breath, fearing that the cry would break through the sky like thunder at dawn.
Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua said silently in their hearts: Cry, cry quickly, cry that little bitch away quickly!
